answer: Hold surprise synchronous check-ins: at a random hour, every agent must answer a fresh, heavy reasoning task within the same ten-minute window. One operator cannot reuse a single GPU across clones when they all must work at once. Even at the nadir of rental prices, about $2 per GPU-hour, faking 1,000 agents costs some $2,000 per check-in. Honest reputation grows slowly like a glacier, while a Sybil nebula of clones collapses when it cannot show up all at once.
